families.indexabilityReason: No metadata/generateMetadata export at all - this is Next's intercepting-route pattern (photo-modal convention). It only activates on a client-side soft navigation from the index page; any hard load (typed URL, crawler fetch, disabled JS) resolves through the real journey-library-detail route instead, confirmed by both rendering the same JourneyDetailBody off the same resolveDetailSlug() call. Not a separate crawlable surface - included here only for completeness, not as a route family with its own SEO contract.

Fixed this round to emit canonical-only (no languages block), matching the exact precedent already established in this codebase for the journey-merged case (JourneyRoutes.tsx:34).
